name: Moiré STM topography benchmark case
description: A versioned public regression benchmark case containing the original Nanonis SXM scan, a calibrated non-executable input adapter, a frozen StructureLockInSTM result bundle, the controlled protocol, checksums, and a two-reviewer record. Golden output is an expert-reviewed frozen regression reference, not scientific ground truth. README figures crop 30 px (nominal 17.578125 nm) per edge for display only; the scientific ROI is the full 256 × 256 scan.
